questionEn: Which of the following corresponds to the material in the paragraph “Simple and complex substances”?
questionUz: Quyidagilardan qaysi biri “Oddiy va murakkab moddalar” bandidagi materialga mos keladi?
choicesEn: substances consisting of atoms of various elements
substances consisting of atoms of the same element
the phenomenon of the formation of several simple substances from one chemical element
changes in the shape of an element that differs from each other in physical and chemical properties
choicesUz: turli elementlarning atomlaridan tashkil topgan moddalar
bir xil element atomlaridan tashkil topgan moddalar
bir kimyoviy elementdan bir nechta oddiy moddalar hosil bo'lish hodisasi
fizik va kimyoviy xossalari bilan bir-biridan farq qiluvchi element shaklining o'zgarishi
explanationEn: Complex substances are substances consisting of atoms of different elements.
explanationUz: Murakkab moddalar - turli elementlarning atomlaridan tashkil topgan moddalar.
